_readme: Baseline for tools/openapi-contract-scan.mjs (finding F-18, WORK/FORWARD_PLAN.md Phase 9.9).
`undocumented` is the number of real backend routes that contracts/openapi.yaml
does not describe. It is a RATCHET: the scan fails when the number grows, so the
gap can only shrink. Document the new route in contracts/openapi.yaml rather than
raising this number. Raising it is allowed only with a stated reason, the same
`phantomAllowlist` holds `METHOD /path` entries the contract documents but the
backend does not serve. It is EMPTY and should stay that way. Nothing compiles
against contracts/openapi.yaml, so an entry here is invisible to every other
check in the repo — it just leaves the contract of record claiming an endpoint
that does not exist. It exists only so a deliberate contract-first workflow
(document, then implement) has a way to land the contract half first; every
entry must name a board item and should be removed the moment the route ships.
